_help.host: Zabbix host name of the controller (OS-Deps-Node triggers tag node={HOST.NAME})
_help.hostname: OpenStack service host name (os-services 'host'); matched with 'contains'
_help.ip: must equal an IP in os_probe.ini 'nodes' (API check triggers tag target=<ip>)
_help.s3_zones: only when several RGW zones are checked from one probe section (os_probe s3_zones); omit for a single s3_url
_help.kinds: optional top-level map to override how a component is modelled: api | vip | quorum | pernode | cluster
